blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on 16 April 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is now one of the largest railway networks in the world.
The Railway Budget was separated from the General Budget in 1924 based on the Acworth Committee recommendations.
The Railway Budget was merged back with the Union Budget in 2017 based on the Bibek Debroy Committee recommendations.
